caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

raw_responses.Chinese:
This bar chart compares the accuracy of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists the three benchmarks, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with linearly spaced major gridlines at 0.5% intervals (e.g., 50, 51, 52, ..., 62). Each benchmark displays a group of six bars, representing the six methods: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). For the Mathverse benchmark, the bars show DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 56%, SRPO at approximately 56%, DAPO at approximately 53%, GRPO at approximately 54%, PPO+Self-reflection at approximately 54%, and PPO at approximately 53%. For the MMLU benchmark, the bars show DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 57%, DAPO at approximately 56%, SRPO at approximately 57%, GRPO at approximately 57%, PPO+Self-reflection at approximately 55%, and PPO at approximately 54.5%. For the Physics benchmark, the bars show DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 61%, DAPO at approximately 58%, SRPO at approximately 60.5%, GRPO at approximately 58%, PPO+Self-reflection at approximately 57%, and PPO at approximately 57%. The bars are grouped by benchmark and are not sorted in any particular order. There are no visual emphasis features such as shading, bolding, or annotations on the bars themselves. The chart uses distinct colors and hatch patterns to differentiate the six methods, with a legend in the top right corner.
